message: CREATE INDEX statement is missing the CONCURRENTLY modifier.
title: Missing CONCURRENTLY on CREATE INDEX
risk: High risk of application downtime due to write locks on the target table during index building.
remediation: Add the CONCURRENTLY keyword to your CREATE INDEX statement.

message: DROP INDEX statement is missing the CONCURRENTLY modifier.
title: Missing CONCURRENTLY on DROP INDEX
risk: High risk of blocking application queries because PostgreSQL locks the table during a standard DROP INDEX.
remediation: Add the CONCURRENTLY keyword to your DROP INDEX statement.

message: Adding a NOT NULL column without a default value is unsafe.
title: Unsafe NOT NULL column addition
risk: Can cause migration failures or app errors if the table contains existing rows, as new columns default to NULL.
remediation: Provide a DEFAULT value when adding a NOT NULL column, or add the column as nullable first.

message: Setting an existing column to NOT NULL is unsafe.
title: Unsafe NOT NULL column addition
risk: Can cause migration failures or app errors if the table contains existing rows, as new columns default to NULL.
remediation: Provide a DEFAULT value when adding a NOT NULL column, or add the column as nullable first.

message: Altering column data type is unsafe and causes table rewrites.
title: Table rewriting type conversions
risk: High risk of locking the table and causing application request queues to saturate.
remediation: Use a dual-column transition strategy: add new column, backfill asynchronously, then rename/drop.

message: Adding a foreign key without NOT VALID is unsafe.
title: Foreign keys without NOT VALID
risk: Blocks table access by acquiring strong locks for historical verification checks.
remediation: Add the NOT VALID clause, then validate constraints using ALTER TABLE VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in a separate transaction.

message: Adding an inline foreign key reference constraint is unsafe. Add the column first, then add the constraint NOT VALID.
title: Foreign keys without NOT VALID
risk: Blocks table access by acquiring strong locks for historical verification checks.
remediation: Add the NOT VALID clause, then validate constraints using ALTER TABLE VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in a separate transaction.

message: CONCURRENTLY index operations cannot run inside a transaction block.
title: CONCURRENTLY inside transaction
risk: PostgreSQL throws an error and aborts the migration if a CONCURRENTLY index command runs within a transaction block.
remediation: Remove BEGIN/COMMIT transaction statements from the migration file, or run CONCURRENTLY operations separately.

title: DROP TABLE / DROP COLUMN protection
risk: High risk of losing production data or causing runtime errors.
remediation: To run, verify safety, back up data, and add the override directive '-- aegis:allow-destructive' comment.

title: SERIAL usage
risk: Older SERIAL types create non-standard sequence objects that can cause sequence ownership bugs during migrations.
remediation: Replace SERIAL with INT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, or BIGSERIAL with BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY.

message: Missing 'SET lock_timeout' statement in PostgreSQL migration.
title: Missing SET lock_timeout
risk: Without a lock_timeout, a migration waiting for a lock can block all subsequent transactions, causing an outage.
remediation: Prepend a 'SET lock_timeout = ...' statement at the start of your migration script.

message: TIMESTAMP without timezone is discouraged. Use TIMESTAMPTZ.
title: TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE
risk: Can cause subtle timezone bugs when querying or comparing records from systems running in different timezones.
remediation: Replace TIMESTAMP or TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE with TIMESTAMPTZ or TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE.
